panels.title: Brokers up
panels.description: Brokers whose JMX exporter answers (3 expected).

panels.title: Active controller
panels.description: Must be exactly 1.

panels.title: Offline partitions
panels.description: Partitions without a leader.

panels.title: Under-min-ISR
panels.description: acks=all writes to these fail.

panels.title: Under-replicated
panels.description: Normal briefly during restarts.

panels.title: Messages in
panels.description: Messages per second, all topics.

panels.title: Produce success
panels.description: SLI: share of successful produce requests (5 min).

panels.title: Firing alerts
panels.description: Alerts from kafka-alerts.yml in this cluster (needs the rules loaded in this Prometheus).

panels.title: Request handler idle
panels.description: Below 40% warning, below 20% critical.

panels.title: Network processor idle
panels.description: Average over the network threads.

panels.title: Produce p99 (broker side)
panels.description: Includes the wait for acks=all replication.

panels.title: Fetch p99 (consumers)
panels.description: Includes long-poll waiting (fetch.max.wait.ms, 500 ms by default).

panels.title: ISR shrinks / expands
panels.description: Frequent changes: unstable network or an overloaded broker.

panels.title: Partitions and leaders per broker
panels.description: Leaders should be spread evenly.

panels.title: Replication lag (max, messages)
panels.description: How far this broker's follower replicas are behind the leaders.

panels.title: GC time
panels.description: Share of time spent in garbage collection.

panels.title: /data used
panels.description: Warning above 75%, critical above 85%.

panels.title: Disk busy (/data device)
panels.description: Busiest disk per host.

panels.title: KRaft: metadata offset per node
panels.description: The lines must stay together; a node falling behind is not replicating metadata.

panels.title: Size on disk per topic (all replicas)
panels.description: Sum over the three replicas; divide by 3 for the data size.

panels.title: Under-replicated partitions per topic
panels.description: Empty when all is well.

panels.title: Lag per group and topic
panels.description: Messages not yet consumed. Growing for 15 min: critical alert.

panels.title: Consumption rate per group
panels.description: Committed messages per second.

panels.title: Members per group
panels.description: 0 members with lag: the consumer is stopped.

panels.title: Connector status
panels.description: One row per connector with its state.

panels.title: Failed tasks per connector
panels.description: Empty when all is well.

panels.title: Record errors
panels.description: Records that failed conversion or transforms in the last 10 minutes.

panels.title: Failed produce requests per topic
panels.description: Topics map to the systems that write to them.

panels.title: Rejected bytes per topic (message too large)
Produce success ratio
panels.description: SLI. Authorization denials are in /var/log/kafka/kafka-authorizer.log, not in metrics.
